units: normalised (100 = average total monthly US gallium-metal imports); only meanVolume = 100 x meanShare is given, no time series
syntheticReason: Sayari bills of lading hold almost no gallium metal. HS 811292 arriving USA (234 rows, all 3 pages pulled in full mode) is a basket: after removing the standard HS text, gallium appears in only ~5 rows for 2023-01..2026-10 (mostly niobium, indium, titanium and mis-coded consolidated cargo). Free-text queries for gallium terms (gallium metal/ingot/6N/oxide/arsenide/nitride, UN 2803, trimethylgallium, GaCl3) gave 93 + 138 rows; after dedup and dropping empty-cylinder returns there are only 6 gallium-METAL lots in 46 months (Kite Metals LUX x3, Mexico x1 month, Turkey x1 in transit), and no Canadian rows at all (truck/air freight is not in US BOL data). The other gallium-bearing rows are MOCVD precursors and GaAs scrap whose gross weights are mostly cylinders and other chemicals. No node reaches 18 months; quarterly metal coverage is <=3 quarters per node. So volumes are left empty; per-node Sayari lot counts are kept in raw as evidence only.

comparison: USGS MCS 2026 (gallium metal, HTS 8112.92.1000, 2021-24): Canada 28 / Japan 22 / China 18 / Germany 16 / other 16 % - used for meanShare. USGS MCS 2025 (2020-23): Japan 24 / China 19 / Germany 19 / Canada 17 / other 21 %. trade.json (Comtrade HS 811292 basket, USD, partners CHN/JPN/KOR/MEX only): totals 58.9M / 84.0M / 49.2M for 2023/24/25; China share 0.557 / 0.635 / 0.320; Korea 37.6% in 2025. Direction agrees with the ban: China falls in 2025. Levels do not: the basket includes indium/germanium/niobium, and Canada and Germany are missing from the covered corridors. USGS MCS 2026 also says 2025 US gallium-metal imports were more than double 2024 at ~$580/kg, while GaAs wafer imports fell 24%. Sayari counts (gallium-bearing US lots 2023-01..2026-10, excl. empties): ca 0, jp 2, cn 33, de 12, other 45 - shipment counts, not volume.

caveats: SYNTHETIC: no time series. volumes{} and periods[] are empty by design; the game must use an illustrative covariance and show the 'Illustrative network - not measured' badge (brief 5.4).

meanShare = USGS 2021-24 average share of US gallium-METAL import value (HTS 8112.92.1000). It predates the Dec-2024 China ban; 2025 China share is much lower (Comtrade basket share fell from 0.635 to 0.320).
GaAs wafers (HS 3818, ~79% of US gallium use per USGS) and MOCVD precursors are not in the shares.
Comtrade HS 811292 is a basket (Ga, Ge, In, Nb, V); Korea's large 2025 value is most likely indium, so it is not used as a gallium share.

Sayari counts in raw are shipment-row counts of gallium-bearing lots, not volumes; most are precursors or scrap with gross weights dominated by packaging. Canada has zero rows because overland freight is not covered.
The UN-2803/precursor query returned 138 rows; only the first 100 were pulled.
All tier-2 shares are assumed except de <- cn-alumina-ga (0.55, BGR 2022 import share used as a proxy).

counterparties.json names Rio Tinto Fer et Titane (Sorel-Tracy); the reported gallium pilot is at Rio Tinto's Saguenay alumina refinery with Indium Corporation. The Sayari entity may be the wrong Rio Tinto unit.
Mexico 2023-10 and Turkey 2025-05 gallium lots name non-US consignees (Kenya, Bolivia free zone): likely transit records, not US consumption.
